claims.claim: H1 FY25 loss driven by lower revenue, inventory write-offs, and corporate cleanup.
claims.quote: First is significantly lower revenue, which is about INR85 crores or INR851 million, while fixed costs have been remaining largely unchanged. Second thing is provision arising from Kaynes due diligence, including inventory write-offs. And third thing is broader corporate cleanup and other adjustments.

claims.claim: Acquisitions resulted in capital reserve and goodwill after purchase price allocation per Ind AS 103.
claims.quote: In FY 2025, the company made two acquisitions, namely Iskraemeco and Sensonic, which resulted in capital reserve of goodwill and goodwill respectively on these transactions after assigning values to the net identifiable, identified assets as part of the purchase price allocation exercise carried out as required under the Ind AS 103.

claims.claim: RPTs were eliminated in consolidated financials; the oversight was a notes omission in a subsidiary.
claims.quote: The related party transactions were appropriately eliminated and consolidated financial statements in accordance with Ind AS. The oversight pertains solely to the notes to the stand-alone financial statements in one of the companies, but the disclosure was inadvertently omitted.

claims.claim: Experimental research is expensed, while targeted product development with revenue streams is capitalized.
claims.quote: So, in our case, what happens is, whenever we do research, that means there is no specific product that is being developed, but the engineers are just experimenting with new concepts and POCs, etcetera. Those are all generally expensed off and they are not capitalized. Only when we identify a particular product with a revenue stream possibility, we take it as development and that is capitalized.

claims.claim: Kaynes will exit full project implementation and operate strictly as a device manufacturer and software provider.
claims.quote: We are also planning to exit from day one. When we took over this company, we wanted only to become a device manufacturer. So, we will no longer be an AMISP company. We will be only device company to various AMISPs. And our software, we will also sell it to them as a service.

claims.claim: Samples have been shipped out to three semiconductor clients, technically starting commercial production.
claims.quote: And all three of them, one of them, we were the first in the country to actually ship out the chipsets, even though we got this thing the last, the approvals the last. And so, the samples have been shipped out, so in some sense, technically, the commercial production has started.
